name: Tina wa Seirei Tsukai
source:
Rahel is a professional swordsman. He takes a job to hunt bandits since it's well paid and takes a female companion with him. He has to cooperate with the female group of bandit hunters "Arabian Knights".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
拉赫尔是一名职业剑客。由于报酬丰厚，他接受了一份狩猎土匪的工作，并带着一名女伴。他必须与女强盗猎人团体“阿拉伯骑士”合作。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
